facts.business: Prospect Consumer Products Limited is a leading player in the cashew processing and premium dry fruits industry in India, specializing in sourcing, processing, and distribution of high-quality cashew kernels and other premium dry fruits across domestic and international markets.

segments.name: B2B cashew processing and dry fruits

capacity_or_capex.item: Commissioning of more automated processing unit

guidance_or_targets.statement: Continue to strengthen B2B customer relationships while building DriFrutz with focus on product quality, credible communication and wider distribution
Expand presence across relevant digital channels, improve sourcing efficiency and focus on extracting greater benefits from investments in automation

key_risks: Time needed to establish a consumer brand
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/transactions entered into by the Company during the financial year with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. Board of Directors of the Company has formulated the Policy on Related Party Transactions.
